HeroSection.saudacao: I turn manual processes into systems that run on their own.

AboutSection.bio1: I'm a back-end developer focused on automation and systems integration. As a Systems Analyst at Gox Internet, I work with the ISP's ERP (IXC) and AI-powered WhatsApp assistants, build GLPI plugins, and create internal tools that remove manual work from the support, HR and IT teams.
AboutSection.bio2: My background spans infrastructure, front-end and ERP, so I see systems end to end: server, database and the person using the screen. I'm always eager to learn and grow, with a growing interest in AI applied to real-world processes.

TimelineSection.job1Desc: Hardware and user support, network maintenance and Raspberry Pi setup for the city hall's internal solutions.
TimelineSection.job2Desc: N1 technical support and deployment of document management solutions with Alfresco Community, Tomcat 7 and PostgreSQL on Linux servers and Docker. Built printer workflows and migrated environments from Windows to Linux.
TimelineSection.job3Title: ERP Systems Analyst — Mercantil Fonte Boa
TimelineSection.job3Desc: Support and setup of the Consinco (TOTVS) ERP, Oracle database management, access control and process automation with Python scripts.
TimelineSection.job4Desc: Web development with PHP and Laravel on the vehicle tracking platform. Built a ticketing platform from scratch and worked with Galileosky tracker data and driver fatigue sensors.
TimelineSection.job5Title: IT Infrastructure Analyst V — Grupo Minas Port
TimelineSection.job5Desc: N2 support, development and maintenance of the company's internal system in C# and .NET, and took part in migrating the physical servers to Microsoft Azure.
TimelineSection.job6Desc: Automation and integration at the ISP: I work with the IXC ERP and AI-powered WhatsApp assistants (OPA Suite), built Gox Assina (electronic contract signing), GLPI plugins and an automated network diagnostic agent.
